Attack Vector: masquerading in a clone of a legitimate application
likely via third-party Android app stores or app-sharing forums
Method of Attack: record every call taking place on the phone
upload recorded phone calls to a remote server
send phone's GPS coordinates to a remote server
upload a copy of every picture taken with the phone's cameras to a remote server
Indicators of Compromise: first sample uploaded on VirusTotal from Russia
subsequent samples uploaded from an Israeli IP
